study: 'Trending together' %R rule grid: both lines dipped, close together, rising together, entered at the EARLIEST bar the rule triggers - every threshold variation, with a held-out confirmation.
registered_at: 2026-10-17 ~01:00 ET, before any return of these rules was computed.
origin: Operator 10/17 after the pre-screen turn FAIL: 'strict criteria ... the lines being close together, there having to be a dip ... a rule set of the lines trending together ... getting in at the earliest moment that rule triggered', 'test variations ... different numbers', and the goal: 'get in before our run gets over, maybe capture 50% of it ... right now we get in at the tail end'.
prior: LOW. Every component was tested alone or in pairs and read ~0 or failed: BOTHUP (n 283k, -0.2 bp), MID (~0), PRE close-together (~0), steep turn (FAIL), slow-line rise (FAIL). The conjunction is untested. Conditions 'dip' and 'close together' pull against each other (out of a dip the fast line is usually far below the slow), so the rule fires only when both lines dipped together.
data: Identical to prescreen_turn_prereg amended_1: warehouse 119 usable sessions 2026-04-28..2026-10-15, 400 seeded names/session (sha256(day|prescreen-sample)) with today's IEX+SIP and the previous session's IEX bars, IEX %R lines warmed on the previous session's last 220 bars, SIP markouts.
rule: At completed bar i: (dip) min(fast over bars i-20..i) <= dip_fast AND min(slow over i-20..i) <= dip_slow; (close) |fast - slow| <= gap; (together) both lines rose (> previous + 0.05) on each of the last rise_bars bars; (early) fast <= early. Entry = SIP open of the minute after the FIRST bar the flag turns on (onset), 09:50-15:30, 15-minute refractory per name.
markout_controls_cost: 10-minute hold (SIP open of the entry bar to the SIP close 9 minutes later); lift = markout minus the same name's random LATER minute (entry+1..+60, seed early-honest-v1 with rule 'TOGETHER'); cross = markout minus a random other sampled name at the same minute; cost 10 bp round trip for PASS, measured 3 bp for PROMISING; day-equal means, day-clustered t.
protocol: Discovery = half A (sessions <= the median session 2026-07-23). Pick ONE cell: the highest day-equal A lift among cells with >= 300 A signals and >= 30 A days. Confirmation = half B (sessions after 2026-07-23), never used for the pick.
pass: PASS = the picked cell in held-out B: lift >= +5 bp with t >= 2.0, net at 10 bp > 0, cross lift > 0, >= 100 signals and >= 6 days. PROMISING = B lift > 0 with t >= 1.5, net at 3 bp > 0, cross > 0. Else FAIL (UNDERPOWERED under the minimums).
information_only: the operator's default cell graded the same way on B
rank correlation of A vs B lift across all cells (about 0 = the grid is noise) and the share of cells with B lift > 0
top 5 A cells with their B results
no_retuning: The grid, the pick rule, the split, the hold, the controls and the cost are fixed. A new grid or a different pick rule is a new prereg.
if_pass: Forward test on paper as a scanner arm for >= 10 sessions, then result-skeptic review.
if_fail: Strict 'trending together' %R rules have no edge at any of these thresholds; recorded for the 10/30 verdict.
declared_deviations: Warm-up on the previous session's RTH IEX bars; live warms on extended-hours bars (prescreen amended F2).
multiplicity: 243 cells are handled by picking on A and confirming one cell on B; the 'capture 50% of the run' goal is measured by the 10-minute lift vs a later minute of the same name.
